headline: Market gave back a slice of Monday's rally: KSE-100 ~177,980 as of 1pm PKT, down ~0.16% on the day after Monday's +3% surge, still ~6% off the Jan ATH — clear of the 10% correction line; SBP confirmed the widely-expected hold at 11.5% (Jul 27 MPC, first of FY27); Mali's price feed still hasn't posted today's intraday move (shows Monday Jul 27's close, Rs 32.42 for AVN) so per-holding figures below are Monday's close, not today's live tape; AVN's sell-half plan (flagged Jul 27, apparently still not executed since holdings are unchanged) is now a day overdue — verify the live price and place the order; EFERT's H1 results/dividend decision is now just 1 day out (Wed Jul 29), with fresh news confirming H1 urea sales hit a 10-year low (537K tons) and inventory has swollen to 694K tons.
market: Tuesday saw the market give back a small part of Monday's big +3% rebound: KSE-100 opened weak and stayed in negative territory through midday, down 279.65 points (-0.16%) to ~177,982.68 as of 1:00pm PKT versus Monday's close of 178,262.33, with an intraday range of 177,903.87-179,123.00 on healthy volume (339.48M shares, ~Rs19.71B traded) — cautious, directionless trading rather than a real reversal. Against the Jan 23, 2026 all-time high of 189,556, today's level puts the drawdown at roughly 6.1%, actually a touch better than Monday's ~7% since most of the rally held. SBP's MPC met Monday (Jul 27) as scheduled and confirmed the consensus call: policy rate held at 11.5% for a second straight meeting, with Governor Jameel Ahmad citing an improved but still risk-exposed outlook (Middle East tensions) and CPI expected to ease further in July toward the 5-7% target band. No market surprise there. Caveat carried over from yesterday: Mali's own price feed (data/prices.json) has not posted an intraday update for today's session yet at review time — it still shows Monday Jul 27's closing prices, so the per-holding P/L figures below reflect Monday's close, not today's actual mark; treat them as a snapshot one session behind. AVN's sell-half plan, flagged for ten straight reviews now, was specifically due yesterday (Mon Jul 27) — holdings data is unchanged from before, suggesting it may not have been executed yet; this is now overdue and should be done today at the live price regardless of the feed lag. EFERT news firmed up since yesterday: H1 2026 urea sales came in at just 537,000 tons — a 10-year low — with inventory having swollen to 694,000 tons on last year's push sales, reinforcing the glut thesis ahead of tomorrow's (Wed Jul 29) board meeting on H1 results and the dividend decision. Two minor positive items worth noting: AIRLINK's board approved a new electric-bike manufacturing project (AirV brand, Lahore SGSEZ) on Jul 23 — a diversification move, stock reacted mildly positive (+2% that day) but no change to the WATCH stance given policy-dependent economics; and MUGHAL fully redeemed its Rs2.5B Sukuk-V on Jul 21/22, a small deleveraging positive. No ex-dividend dates found within the next 3 days for any holding.
